info.title: Votrix Managed Agents
info.description:
Build and operate long-running agents through a durable, Organization-scoped REST API. This reference is generated from the same FastAPI application that serves production traffic, so request fields and response models stay aligned with the code.

> **Base URL** `https://managed-agents.votrixai.com`

Every `/v1` request requires the current `votrix-managed-agents-beta: votrix-managed-agents-2026-04-01` header plus either an `x-api-key` header or the same key as a Bearer token. Choose an endpoint to inspect its schema, copy a code sample, or send a request.
